title: The BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions… (CVE-2026-1212)
description: The BuddyPress plugin for WordPress up to and including version 14.4.0 contains an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability in the Messages REST API endpoint. The vulnerability arises because the get_item_permissions_check function trusts a client-supplied user_id parameter instead of verifying the authenticated user's ID. This flaw allows authenticated users with Subscriber-level access or higher to read, update, or delete private message threads of other users by specifying their user ID in requests.
